bots.connect.blurb_web.en: A private chat page on this computer
bots.connect.blurb_web.zh-CN: 此电脑上的私密聊天页面

bots.connect.blurb_telegram.zh-CN: 用手机给机器人发消息

bots.connect.blurb_slack.en: DM it or @mention it in channels
bots.connect.blurb_slack.zh-CN: 私信机器人，或在频道中 @提及它

bots.connect.blurb_discord.en: DM it or @mention it in a server
bots.connect.blurb_discord.zh-CN: 私信机器人，或在服务器中 @提及它

bots.connect.blurb_whatsapp.en: Via Meta’s Cloud API and a tunnel
bots.connect.blurb_whatsapp.zh-CN: 通过 Meta 云 API 和隧道连接

bots.connect.botfather.en: BotFather is Telegram’s official bot for creating bots.
bots.connect.botfather.zh-CN: BotFather 是 Telegram 官方提供的机器人创建工具。

bots.connect.newbot.en: Send this to BotFather, then answer its two questions: a display name (for example “{name}”) and a username ending in “bot”.
bots.connect.newbot.zh-CN: 将此命令发给 BotFather，然后回答两个问题：显示名称（例如“{name}”），以及以“bot”结尾的用户名。

bots.connect.token_warning.en: It looks like 123456789:AAE…. Anyone with it can control the bot, so keep it private.
bots.connect.token_warning.zh-CN: 令牌形如 123456789:AAE…。持有令牌的任何人都能控制机器人，请妥善保密。

bots.connect.slack_create.en: This opens Slack with the name, permissions, events and Socket Mode filled in. Pick your workspace, review, then press Create.
bots.connect.slack_create.zh-CN: 打开 Slack 后，名称、权限、事件和 Socket Mode 均已填好。选择工作区，检查配置，然后点击创建（Create）。

bots.connect.slack_install.en: In the app’s page, open Install App → Install to Workspace → Allow. Copy the Bot User OAuth Token.
bots.connect.slack_install.zh-CN: 在应用页面依次点击安装应用（Install App）→ 安装到工作区（Install to Workspace）→ 允许（Allow），然后复制机器人用户 OAuth 令牌（Bot User OAuth Token）。

bots.connect.slack_app_token.en: Open Basic Information → App-Level Tokens → Generate Token and Scopes. Name it anything, add the scope connections:write, generate, and copy it.
bots.connect.slack_app_token.zh-CN: 依次打开基本信息（Basic Information）→ 应用级令牌（App-Level Tokens）→ 生成令牌及权限范围（Generate Token and Scopes）。名称可任意填写，添加 connections:write 权限范围，生成并复制令牌。

bots.connect.discord_create.en: Press New Application, name it “{name}”, and accept the terms.
bots.connect.discord_create.zh-CN: 点击新建应用（New Application），将其命名为“{name}”，并接受条款。

bots.connect.discord_read.en: Open the Bot tab, turn on Message Content Intent under Privileged Gateway Intents, and press Save Changes.
bots.connect.discord_read.zh-CN: 打开机器人（Bot）选项卡，在特权网关意图（Privileged Gateway Intents）下启用消息内容意图（Message Content Intent），然后点击保存更改（Save Changes）。

bots.connect.discord_token.en: Still on the Bot tab, press Reset Token, confirm, and copy it. (The Client Secret and Public Key are different values.)
bots.connect.discord_token.zh-CN: 仍在机器人（Bot）选项卡中，点击重置令牌（Reset Token），确认后复制令牌。注意：客户端密钥（Client Secret）和公钥（Public Key）是不同的值。

bots.connect.discord_invite.en: After you connect, an Add to server button appears here with the right permissions already chosen.
bots.connect.discord_invite.zh-CN: 连接成功后，这里会出现“添加到服务器”按钮，并已选好所需权限。

bots.connect.meta_create.en: Choose Other → Business, then add the WhatsApp product. Meta gives you a free test number.
bots.connect.meta_create.zh-CN: 选择其他（Other）→ 商业（Business），然后添加 WhatsApp 产品。Meta 会提供一个免费测试号码。

bots.connect.meta_portal.zh-CN: 打开 Meta 开发者平台

bots.connect.meta_phone.en: In WhatsApp → API Setup, copy the Phone number ID (a long number, not the phone number itself). Add your own phone under To so the test number may message you.
bots.connect.meta_phone.zh-CN: 在 WhatsApp → API 设置（API Setup）中，复制电话号码 ID（Phone number ID；一串长数字，并非电话号码本身）。在收件人（To）下添加您的手机号码，以便测试号码向您发消息。

bots.connect.phone_id.zh-CN: 电话号码 ID（Phone number ID）

bots.connect.meta_access.en: The temporary token on API Setup works for 24 hours. For one that lasts, create a system user with WhatsApp permissions and generate its token.
bots.connect.meta_access.zh-CN: API 设置（API Setup）中的临时令牌有效期为 24 小时。如需长期使用，请创建具有 WhatsApp 权限的系统用户，并生成其令牌。

bots.connect.meta_secret.en: Open App settings → Basic → App secret → Show. PandaCode uses it to check that messages really come from Meta.
bots.connect.meta_secret.zh-CN: 依次打开应用设置（App settings）→ 基本（Basic）→ 应用密钥（App secret）→ 显示（Show）。PandaCode 使用它验证消息确实来自 Meta。

bots.connect.meta_next.en: After you connect, the steps for the webhook (with everything to copy) appear on the channel.
bots.connect.meta_next.zh-CN: 连接成功后，频道中会显示 Webhook 配置步骤和需要复制的全部内容。

bots.connect.works.zh-CN: 验证成功，以 {name} 身份连接

bots.connect.storage.en: Tokens are stored securely on this computer. The agent never sees them.
bots.connect.storage.zh-CN: 令牌安全地保存在此电脑上，智能体无法看到它们。

bots.connect.pair.en: Send it any message. It replies with a four-digit code, which also appears under People below. Press Approve and you’re talking.
bots.connect.pair.zh-CN: 向机器人发送任意消息，它会回复一个四位数配对码，配对码也会显示在下方“联系人”中。点击“批准”后即可开始对话。

bots.connect.slack_chat.en: Find the bot under Apps in the sidebar and message it, or /invite it to a channel and @mention it.
bots.connect.slack_chat.zh-CN: 在侧栏的应用（Apps）中找到机器人并给它发消息，或使用 /invite 将它邀请到频道后 @提及它。

bots.connect.authorize.en: Choose a server you manage and press Authorize.
bots.connect.authorize.zh-CN: 选择您管理的服务器，然后点击授权（Authorize）。

bots.connect.tunnel.en: Meta delivers messages over HTTPS, so this computer needs a public address. The quickest is a free Cloudflare tunnel; run these in Terminal and keep the second one open:
bots.connect.tunnel.zh-CN: Meta 通过 HTTPS 推送消息，因此此电脑需要一个公网地址。最快的方式是使用免费的 Cloudflare 隧道；在终端运行以下命令，并保持第二条命令运行：

bots.connect.tunnel_address.en: It prints an address ending in trycloudflare.com. That address changes each time the tunnel starts; for a fixed one, use Tailscale Funnel instead:
bots.connect.tunnel_address.zh-CN: 命令会输出一个以 trycloudflare.com 结尾的地址。每次启动隧道时地址都会变化；如需固定地址，可改用 Tailscale Funnel：

bots.connect.webhook_paste.en: In Meta, open WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook → Edit and paste:
bots.connect.webhook_paste.zh-CN: 在 Meta 中依次打开 WhatsApp → 配置（Configuration）→ Webhook → 编辑（Edit），然后粘贴以下内容：

bots.connect.webhook_verify.en: Press Verify and save, then under Webhook fields press Manage and subscribe to messages. The status above turns to “Webhook verified”.
bots.connect.webhook_verify.zh-CN: 点击验证并保存（Verify and save），然后在 Webhook 字段（Webhook fields）下点击管理（Manage），订阅 messages。上方状态将变为“Webhook 已验证”。

bots.connect.message_whatsapp.zh-CN: 给您的 WhatsApp 号码发消息

bots.connect.message_phone.en: Message your WhatsApp business number from your phone.
bots.connect.message_phone.zh-CN: 用手机向您的 WhatsApp 商业号码发消息。

bots.connect.rotate_title.en: Create a new web chat link?
bots.connect.rotate_title.zh-CN: 创建新的网页聊天链接？

bots.connect.rotate_body.en: Pages opened with the current link stop working right away. Use this if the link was shared by mistake.
bots.connect.rotate_body.zh-CN: 使用当前链接打开的页面会立即失效。如果链接被误分享，请使用此操作。

bots.connect.tailscale.en: Install Tailscale on this computer and your phone and sign in to both. Then run this in Terminal:
bots.connect.tailscale.zh-CN: 在此电脑和手机上安装 Tailscale，并在两端登录同一账户。然后在终端运行此命令：

bots.connect.tailscale_address.en: It shows an address like https://your-mac.tailnet.ts.net.
bots.connect.tailscale_address.zh-CN: 命令会显示形如 https://your-mac.tailnet.ts.net 的地址。

bots.panels.schedule_prompt.en: Check my GitHub notifications and summarize anything that needs me
bots.panels.schedule_prompt.zh-CN: 检查我的 GitHub 通知，汇总需要我处理的事项

bots.panels.new_link_warning.en: New link: pages opened with the old link stop working
bots.panels.new_link_warning.zh-CN: 新链接：使用旧链接打开的页面会立即失效

bots.panels.skill_files.zh-CN: 机器人工作区中的文件

bots.panels.mcp_unsupported.zh-CN: 此机器人的运行器不支持

bots.panels.remove_body.en: {name} stops listening on {channel}, and its saved tokens are deleted.
bots.panels.remove_body.zh-CN: {name} 将停止监听 {channel}，保存的令牌也会被删除。

bots.shared.empty.en: No messages yet. @mention a bot or write to the lead.
bots.shared.empty.zh-CN: 暂无消息。@提及一个机器人，或给负责人发送消息。

bots.shared.add_members.en: Add bots in channel settings to start work.
bots.shared.add_members.zh-CN: 在频道设置中添加机器人，即可开始工作。

bots.shared.keyboard.en: Enter to send. Shift Enter for a new line.
bots.shared.keyboard.zh-CN: 按 Enter 发送，按 Shift+Enter 换行。

bots.shared.prompt.zh-CN: 向 {name} 发消息…最多可 @提及两个机器人

bots.thread.next_model.en: {running} finishes this turn. {next} starts with the next one.
bots.thread.next_model.zh-CN: 本轮由 {running} 完成，下一轮开始使用 {next}。

bots.thread.settings_hint.en: Profile, memory, schedules, channels and rules
bots.thread.settings_hint.zh-CN: 资料、记忆、定时任务、频道和规则

bots.thread.resume_hint.en: Resume: schedules, check-ins and channels continue
bots.thread.resume_hint.zh-CN: 恢复：继续定时任务、定期检查和频道消息

bots.thread.pause_hint.en: Pause: stop work and hold schedules and messages
bots.thread.pause_hint.zh-CN: 暂停：停止工作，暂缓定时任务和消息

bots.thread.suggest_0.en: Research the latest news on a topic I care about.
bots.thread.suggest_0.zh-CN: 研究我关心的话题的最新动态。

bots.thread.suggest_1.en: Compare three options and recommend one.
bots.thread.suggest_1.zh-CN: 比较三个方案，并推荐其中一个。

bots.thread.suggest_2.en: Draft a short post about what I shipped this week.
bots.thread.suggest_2.zh-CN: 根据我本周发布的内容起草一篇短文。

bots.thread.suggest_4.en: Summarize my spending categories this month.
bots.thread.suggest_4.zh-CN: 汇总我本月的支出分类。

bots.thread.suggest_5.en: Remind me of bills due this week.
bots.thread.suggest_5.zh-CN: 提醒我本周到期的账单。

bots.thread.suggest_6.en: Review the latest changes for bugs.
bots.thread.suggest_6.zh-CN: 检查最新改动中是否存在缺陷。

bots.thread.suggest_7.en: Explain how this project is structured.

bots.thread.suggest_8.en: Draft a friendly reply to a customer question.
bots.thread.suggest_8.zh-CN: 针对客户的问题起草一份友好的回复。

bots.thread.suggest_9.zh-CN: 按紧急程度整理这些消息。

bots.thread.suggest_10.en: Remember that I prefer short, direct answers.
bots.thread.suggest_10.zh-CN: 记住我更喜欢简短直接的回答。

bots.thread.suggest_11.en: Every weekday at 9, send me a summary of what changed.
bots.thread.suggest_11.zh-CN: 每个工作日早上 9 点，向我发送变更摘要。

bots.thread.suggest_12.en: What can you help me with?

bots.thread.remove_reaction.zh-CN: 移除您的 {emoji} 表情回应

bots.settings.hold_until.en: Your message has not started. Send it to another model now, or wait until {time}.
bots.settings.hold_until.zh-CN: 您的消息尚未开始处理。可立即发送给其他模型，或等待至 {time}。

bots.settings.limit_back.en: Usage limit ended. Switched back to {model}.
bots.settings.limit_back.zh-CN: 用量限制已解除，已切回 {model}。

bots.settings.limit_switch.zh-CN: 已达到用量上限，已切换至 {model}。

bots.settings.error_back.en: Switched back to {model} after the provider error.
bots.settings.error_back.zh-CN: 服务商错误恢复后，已切回 {model}。

bots.settings.hold_manual.en: Your message has not started. Send it to another model now, or dismiss this hold and retry manually.
bots.settings.hold_manual.zh-CN: 您的消息尚未开始处理。可立即发送给其他模型，或取消此次等待并手动重试。

bots.settings.section_profile.en: Who the bot is, how it works and what runs it.
bots.settings.section_profile.zh-CN: 机器人的身份、工作方式和运行配置。

bots.settings.section_channels.en: Talk to it from a browser, Telegram, Slack, Discord or WhatsApp.
bots.settings.section_channels.zh-CN: 通过浏览器、Telegram、Slack、Discord 或 WhatsApp 与机器人交流。

bots.settings.section_schedules.en: Recurring or one-off work the bot starts on its own.
bots.settings.section_schedules.zh-CN: 由机器人自行启动的周期性或一次性工作。

bots.settings.section_memory.en: Kept across conversations. The bot adds its own as it learns.
bots.settings.section_memory.zh-CN: 在不同对话间保留。机器人也会在学习时添加记忆。

bots.settings.section_skills.en: Library skills and MCP servers this bot uses, by reference. Nothing is copied.
bots.settings.section_skills.zh-CN: 机器人通过引用使用的技能库技能和 MCP 服务器，不会复制内容。

bots.settings.section_activity.en: Conversations, approval rules and everything the bot did.
bots.settings.section_activity.zh-CN: 对话、审批规则，以及机器人的所有活动。

bots.settings.permission_auto.en: Edits files in its workspace without asking
bots.settings.permission_auto.zh-CN: 修改工作区内文件时无需询问

bots.settings.permission_ask.zh-CN: 编辑文件和执行命令前先询问

bots.settings.permission_review.en: A reviewer model approves safe steps and asks you about the rest
bots.settings.permission_review.zh-CN: 由审查模型批准安全步骤，其余步骤向您询问

bots.settings.permission_full.zh-CN: 无需询问即可执行任何操作

bots.settings.permission_plan.en: Reads and plans, never changes anything
bots.settings.permission_plan.zh-CN: 只读取和规划，不做任何修改

bots.settings.suggest_research_role.en: Digs into questions and reports back
bots.settings.suggest_research_role.zh-CN: 深入研究问题并汇报结果

bots.settings.suggest_research_purpose.en: Research the questions I bring you using the web and files on this computer. Lead with the answer, then the evidence, and cite sources with links.
bots.settings.suggest_research_purpose.zh-CN: 利用网络和此电脑上的文件研究我提出的问题。先给出答案，再列出证据，并通过链接注明来源。

bots.settings.suggest_inbox_role.en: Sorts what needs me from what can wait
bots.settings.suggest_inbox_role.zh-CN: 区分需要我处理和可以等待的事项

bots.settings.suggest_inbox_purpose.en: When I forward messages or notifications, sort them into needs me today, can wait, and ignore. Draft short replies for the first group, but never send anything yourself.
bots.settings.suggest_inbox_purpose.zh-CN: 当我转发消息或通知时，将它们分为今天需要我处理、可以等待和可以忽略三类。为第一类起草简短回复，但绝不要自行发送。

bots.settings.suggest_chief_role.zh-CN: 帮我有序安排每周事务

bots.settings.suggest_chief_purpose.en: Track my commitments, follow-ups and deadlines. Each morning, tell me my top three priorities and anything about to slip. Ask before acting on my behalf.
bots.settings.suggest_chief_purpose.zh-CN: 跟踪我的承诺、待跟进事项和截止日期。每天早晨告诉我最重要的三件事，以及可能延误的事项。代我采取行动前先征求同意。

bots.settings.suggest_review_role.zh-CN: 在发布前审查代码改动

bots.settings.suggest_review_purpose.en: Review the diffs and pull requests I point you to. Flag bugs, risky changes and missing tests first, style last. Suggest concrete fixes, and run the tests before saying something works.
bots.settings.suggest_review_purpose.zh-CN: 审查我指定的差异和拉取请求。优先指出缺陷、高风险改动和缺少的测试，最后再考虑代码风格。给出具体修复建议，确认功能有效前先运行测试。

bots.settings.suggest_release_role.en: Turns merged work into release notes
bots.settings.suggest_release_role.zh-CN: 将已合并的工作整理成发布说明

bots.settings.suggest_release_purpose.en: When I ask, read the commits and merged pull requests since the last release tag and write release notes grouped into New, Improved and Fixed, in plain language for users.
bots.settings.suggest_release_purpose.zh-CN: 在我提出要求时，阅读自上次发布标签以来的提交和已合并的拉取请求，用面向用户的通俗语言，按新增、改进和修复分类撰写发布说明。

bots.settings.suggest_standup_purpose.en: Each weekday morning, look at what changed in my projects since yesterday and draft a short standup: done, next, and anything blocking. Keep it under 120 words.
bots.settings.suggest_standup_purpose.zh-CN: 每个工作日早晨，查看我的项目自昨天以来的变化，起草简短的晨会汇报：已完成、下一步和阻碍事项。控制在 120 字以内。

bots.settings.suggest_monitor_role.en: Watches things and tells me when they change
bots.settings.suggest_monitor_role.zh-CN: 监测变化并及时通知我

bots.settings.suggest_monitor_purpose.en: Check the pages, feeds or commands I give you. Only message me when something meaningfully changed, with the before, the after and a link.
bots.settings.suggest_monitor_purpose.zh-CN: 检查我提供的页面、订阅源或命令。仅在发生有意义的变化时向我发送消息，说明变化前后的情况并附上链接。

bots.settings.suggest_writer_role.en: Drafts and edits in my voice
bots.settings.suggest_writer_role.zh-CN: 用我的风格起草和编辑文字

bots.settings.suggest_writer_purpose.en: Help me draft and edit posts, emails and docs. Match my tone, keep it tight, and offer one alternative for any line you change a lot.
bots.settings.suggest_writer_purpose.zh-CN: 帮我起草和编辑文章、邮件及文档。保持我的语气，文字简洁；对于大幅改写的句子，再提供一个备选版本。

bots.settings.soul_size.en: {name} is larger than 64 KB. Shorten it and try again.
bots.settings.soul_size.zh-CN: {name} 超过 64 KB，请缩短内容后重试。

bots.settings.soul_encoding.en: {name} is not UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 Markdown and try again.
bots.settings.soul_encoding.zh-CN: {name} 不是 UTF-8 文本，请保存为 UTF-8 编码的 Markdown 后重试。

bots.settings.instructions_hint.en: How it should work, what to always or never do
bots.settings.instructions_hint.zh-CN: 说明工作方式、必须遵循和禁止执行的事项

bots.settings.notifications_hint.en: Message you when it finishes work you were not watching
bots.settings.notifications_hint.zh-CN: 完成您未在查看的工作时向您发送消息

bots.settings.while_working_hint.en: What a new message does while the bot is busy
bots.settings.while_working_hint.zh-CN: 机器人忙碌时如何处理新消息

bots.settings.show_plan.en: Show the plan before long tasks
bots.settings.show_plan.zh-CN: 长任务开始前显示计划

bots.settings.goals_hint.en: One per line. Check-ins work toward these.
bots.settings.goals_hint.zh-CN: 每行一个目标，定期检查时会推进这些目标。

bots.settings.resume_hint.en: Resume: schedules, check-ins and channels continue
bots.settings.resume_hint.zh-CN: 恢复：继续定时任务、定期检查和频道消息

bots.settings.pause_hint.en: Pause: stop work and hold schedules and messages
bots.settings.pause_hint.zh-CN: 暂停：停止工作，暂缓定时任务和消息

bots.settings.full_body.en: It can run any command and change any file this computer allows, without asking first.
bots.settings.full_body.zh-CN: 机器人将无需事先询问，即可执行任何命令，并修改此电脑允许访问的任何文件。

bots.settings.reset_body.en: This deletes its conversations, memories, schedules and activity. Its instructions, channels and rules stay.
bots.settings.reset_body.zh-CN: 此操作会删除机器人的对话、记忆、定时任务和活动记录。指令、频道和规则将保留。

bots.settings.delete_body.en: This removes the bot, its conversations and its channel connections. Its workspace folder stays on disk.
bots.settings.delete_body.zh-CN: 此操作会删除机器人、它的对话和频道连接。工作区文件夹将保留在磁盘上。

bots.settings.purpose_example.en: Describe its job, what to always do, and what to never do
bots.settings.purpose_example.zh-CN: 描述它的职责、必须做的事和绝不能做的事

bots.settings.soul_example.en:
# Leo
Dry wit, fiercely loyal, blunt under pressure.
bots.settings.soul_example.zh-CN:
